attributes.title: reset_demo_folder
attributes.description: Deletes every tag and UDT definition under the two 'Exchange/Tag Import Agent' root folders, so the demo can be run again from empty. Nothing outside those folders can be reached by this tool. Destructive: call it only when the user explicitly asks to clear, reset, or delete the old demo tags, and pass confirm=true to acknowledge that. Report the count it removed.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true. Set it only when the user has asked for the delete in this conversation.
